items.originalTitle: Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll hit with Azerbaijan GP grid penalties for Honda F1 power unit changes
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin drivers Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll will start from the back of the grid at the Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix after receiving grid penalties for fitting new Honda power unit components. Both had already suffered grid drops earlier this year due to Honda's reliability woes.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔因本田F1动力单元更换在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中被罚退发车格。
两位阿斯顿马丁车手将在本周末的F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛中使用全新的本田动力单元。
阿斯顿马丁的费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔因更换本田动力单元部件而受到发车格处罚，将在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛中从队尾发车。
由于本田的可靠性问题，阿隆索和斯特罗尔今年早些时候已经遭受过罚退，两人都无望遵守本赛季四台引擎的配额。
阿斯顿马丁及其动力单元合作伙伴本田现已决定为两辆赛车安装最新一批动力单元。
阿隆索将安装第五台V6引擎和涡轮增压器，以及第九套辅助部件。由于这是这位两届世界冠军首次超出其引擎和涡轮配额，他因此各被罚退10位，同时因其余部件再被罚退5位。
由于持续的可靠性问题，兰斯·斯特罗尔和费尔南多·阿隆索在2026年引擎配额上采取了相反的方向。
斯特罗尔将使用第六台涡轮、第七个电池、第六个控制电子单元和第八套辅助部件。由于这位加拿大人在这四项上均已超出配额，他因此收到四个罚退5位的处罚，总计20位。
如果车手受到超过15位的罚退，他们必须从队尾发车，不过对阿斯顿马丁而言，这一规则只是技术性规定。
两位车手在二练中排名垫底，只有凯迪拉克的瓦尔特利·博塔斯在周四上午的一练中垫底。阿隆索在二练中仅跑了九圈，便因动力单元疑似漏油而返回车库。
梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔在巴库城市赛道的二练中轻松领先，其队友、领跑车手积分的基米·安东内利紧随其后。
detailEn: Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll hit with Azerbaijan GP grid penalties for Honda F1 power unit changes
Both Aston Martin drivers will take a fresh Honda power unit at this weekend's Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll will start from the back of the grid at F1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix after receiving grid penalties for fitting new Honda power unit components.
Alonso and Stroll had already suffered grid drops earlier this year as Honda's reliability woes meant neither driver had any hope of sticking to the season's allowance of four engines.
Aston Martin and its power unit partner Honda have now decided to install the latest batch of power units across both cars.

Alonso will fit a fifth V6 engine and turbocharger as well a ninth set of ancillary components. As it's the first time the two-time world champion exceeds his engine and turbo allowance, he is slapped with a 10-place penalty for each, while being docked an additional five-place penalty for the remaining components.
Lance Stroll and Fernando Alonso have gone opposite ways on their 2026 engine allocation due to enduring reliability issues.

Stroll is taking a sixth turbo, seventh battery, sixth control electronics unit and eighth set of ancillary components. As the Canadian had already exceeded his allowance on each of those four elements, the Canadian received four five-place grid penalties for a total of 20.
If drivers receive grid drops of more than 15 places, they are required to start for the back of the grid, though in Aston Martin's case that rule is just a technicality.

Both drivers finished bottom in FP2, with only Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas in Thursday morning's FP1 session. Alonso only managed nine laps in second practice before disappearing into the garage with a suspected oil leak on the power unit.
Mercedes driver George Russell convincingly led the way in FP2 on the Baku City Circuit ahead of his championship leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli.
keyPointsZh: 阿隆索将使用第五台V6引擎和涡轮增压器以及第九套辅助部件，因首次超出引擎和涡轮配额各被罚退10位，其余部件再罚退5位。
斯特罗尔将使用第六台涡轮、第七个电池、第六个控制电子单元和第八套辅助部件，因四项均已超配额，共被罚退20位。
二练中两人排名垫底，阿隆索仅跑九圈便因疑似动力单元漏油返回车库；梅赛德斯车手拉塞尔在二练中领先。
keyPointsEn: Alonso will fit a fifth V6 engine and turbocharger as well as a ninth set of ancillary components, receiving a 10-place penalty for each of the first two and an additional five-place penalty for the remaining components.
Stroll is taking a sixth turbo, seventh battery, sixth control electronics unit and eighth set of ancillary components, receiving four five-place grid penalties for a total of 20.
Both drivers finished bottom in FP2, with Alonso managing only nine laps before returning to the garage with a suspected oil leak on the power unit; Mercedes driver George Russell led FP2.

items.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛二练：拉塞尔最快
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛第二节练习赛中做出最快圈速，领先梅赛德斯队友、F1积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利。
items.originalTitle: What happened in second Azerbaijan GP F1 practice
items.summaryEn: George Russell set the fastest time in second practice for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, finishing well clear of Mercedes team-mate and Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔延续了阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末的强劲开局，在第二节练习赛中做出最快圈速，大幅领先梅赛德斯队友、F1积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利。
在巴库城市街道赛道上，拉塞尔的梅赛德斯和马克斯·维斯塔潘的红牛在练习赛初段与迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯交替做出最快圈速，随后拉塞尔换上一套软胎进行排位赛模拟。
但这次尝试在拉塞尔的出场圈就被打断，F1新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德驾驶赛车公牛在通过狭窄的城堡路段时，右后胎撞上了护墙。
红旗出示以清理这起事故时，排名依次为维斯塔潘、拉塞尔、诺里斯、刘易斯·汉密尔顿的法拉利、伊萨克·哈贾尔的红牛——他因引擎问题错过了第一节练习赛的大部分时间——以及夏尔·勒克莱尔。
练习赛恢复后，拉塞尔成为第一位圈速低于1分44秒的车手，以1分43秒7的成绩领先维斯塔潘0.4秒，维斯塔潘此前曾抱怨他升级版红牛“不断需要反打方向”，因为“我的后轴在离地”。
拉塞尔又削去0.4秒，最终以1分43秒347的最快圈速结束练习赛，尽管他在最后一个直道上需要绕开加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托缓慢行驶的奥迪。
这一路段本周已被标记为特别危险区域，尤其是当处于飞驰圈的车手遇到正在冷却圈/充电圈的车手时。
利亚姆·劳森在该路段起始处的弯道中恰好遇到汉密尔顿的法拉利，汉密尔顿将在练习赛后因劳森所称的“危险”驾驶接受赛会干事调查。
安东内利因梅赛德斯液压问题错过了第一节练习赛的大部分时间，在第二节练习赛中看起来比拉塞尔慢一步，最终落后超过半秒——他最终将自己的梅赛德斯排在拉塞尔和维斯塔潘的红牛之间。
维斯塔潘比勒克莱尔的法拉利快不到0.3秒，汉密尔顿再落后不到0.2秒，迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里分列第六和第八，中间隔着意大利大奖赛杆位得主皮埃尔·加斯利的阿尔派——三人都做出1分44秒8。
回归的哈贾尔驾驶另一辆红牛以1分44秒8排名第九，即将离开哈斯的埃斯特班·奥康位列第十。
弗兰科·科拉平托的阿尔派和劳森的赛车公牛紧随其后，排在塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前，佩雷斯利用皮亚斯特里迈凯伦的尾流和法拉利最新的ADUO 2引擎升级——佩雷斯的凯迪拉克队友瓦尔特利·博塔斯估计价值0.2秒——做出第13快圈速。
这使得领先的凯迪拉克排在两辆奥迪、两辆威廉姆斯、林德布拉德撞坏的赛车公牛、博塔斯、奥利·贝尔曼抛锚的哈斯和两辆阿斯顿·马丁-本田之前。
detailEn: George Russell continued his strong start to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend by setting the fastest time in second practice, well clear of Mercedes team-mate and Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

Russell’s Mercedes and the Red Bull of Max Verstappen traded fastest times in the early part of the session with McLaren’s Lando Norris on the Baku City street circuit, before Russell bolted on a set of soft tyres for a qualifying simulation.
But that run was cut short on Russell’s out-lap when F1 rookie Arvid Lindblad clouted the wall with his Racing Bulls’ right rear tyre while navigating the narrow castle section.

As the red flags came out to clear up that shunt, the order stood as Verstappen, Russell, Norris, Lewis Hamilton’s Ferrari, Isack Hadjar’s Red Bull - making up for missing most of FP1 to an engine problem - and Charles Leclerc.

After the session resumed Russell was the first driver to lap below 1m44s, cutting the timing beam at 1m43.7s to lead the way by four tenths from Verstappen, who earlier had complained of “constantly counter-steering” his upgraded Red Bull because “my rear axle is coming off the ground”.
Russell shaved a further four tenths off to finish the session with a 1m43.347s best, despite needing to swerve around Gabriel Bortoleto’s slow Audi on the final straight.
This section has been flagged already as an area of particular danger this weekend, especially when cars on hot laps come across those on cool-down/battery recharge laps.

Liam Lawson encountered Hamilton’s Ferrari in precisely this scenario through the kinks at the start of that section and Hamilton will be investigated by the stewards after the session for what Lawson called "dangerous" driving.

Having missed a large chunk of FP1 to a hydraulic problem on his Mercedes, Antonelli looked a step behind Russell in FP2 and finished up over half a second off the pace - having eventually slotted his Mercedes between Russell and Verstappen’s Red Bull in the times.

Verstappen was just under three tenths clear of Leclerc’s Ferrari, with Hamilton just under two tenths further back, and the McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri in sixth and eighth, split by Italian GP pole winner Pierre Gasly’s Alpine - all three on a 1m44.8s.
Returnee Hadjar ended the session ninth in the other Red Bull, also on a 1m44.8s, while soon-to-be ex-Haas driver Esteban Ocon rounded out the top 10.

Franco Colapinto’s Alpine and Lawson’s Racing Bulls were next, just ahead of Sergio Perez, who made good use of a tow from Piastri’s McLaren and Ferrari’s latest ADUO 2 engine upgrade - reckoned to be worth 0.2s by Perez’s Cadillac team-mate Valtteri Bottas - to set the 13th quickest time.
That put the lead Cadillac ahead of both Audis, both Williamses, Lindblad’s crumpled Racing Bulls, Bottas, the broken down Haas of Ollie Bearman and the two Aston Martin-Hondas.
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔的最快圈速为1分43秒347，维斯塔潘落后约0.4秒位列第二。
新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德在城堡路段撞墙，引发红旗。
汉密尔顿因被利亚姆·劳森称为“危险”驾驶，将在练习赛后接受赛会干事调查。
keyPointsEn: Russell's best lap was 1m43.347s, with Verstappen about four tenths behind in second.
Rookie Arvid Lindblad hit the wall at the castle section, bringing out red flags.
Hamilton will be investigated by the stewards after the session for what Liam Lawson called "dangerous" driving.

detailZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛：乔治·拉塞尔在第二节练习赛中做出最快圈速，领先基米·安东内利，在巴库取得统治性开局
梅赛德斯在阿塞拜疆周末开局强势，乔治·拉塞尔早早展现出飞驰状态；红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘是唯一差距在一秒内的车手；周五巴库第三节练习赛于上午9点30分进行，排位赛下午1点开始，均在天空体育 F1直播
阿塞拜疆大奖赛周四练习赛集锦。
乔治·拉塞尔完成了令人印象深刻的练习赛双料最快，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末的统治性开局中超越了积分榜领先的队友基米·安东内利。
梅赛德斯的拉塞尔延续了当天早些时候首节练习赛排名第一的状态，继续位居成绩榜首位，这一次在充满挑战的巴库街道赛道上以半秒优势完赛。
安东内利在2026年车手总冠军争夺中以81分领先拉塞尔，但由于液压泄漏导致赛车在首节练习赛中途停下，他的周四并不顺利。

马克斯·维斯塔潘驾驶升级版红牛赛车获得第三，为开局不错的一天收官，不过他落后领先者0.8秒。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛第二节练习赛中，小红牛的利亚姆·劳森因一次险情对刘易斯·汉密尔顿感到不满。
其他所有车手都落后超过一秒，包括法拉利和迈凯伦。夏尔·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿分列第四和第五，迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里排名第六和第八。
诺里斯将迈凯伦与领先者的差距形容为“相当糟糕”。
皮埃尔·加斯利为阿尔派列第七，回归的伊萨克·哈贾尔为红牛列第九，埃斯特班·奥康——其哈斯席位在2027年似乎将另有归属——排名第十。
小红牛的阿维德·林德布拉德在充满挑战的巴库单圈中于狭窄的城堡路段撞车，引发了周四唯一一次红旗。
阿维德·林德布拉德在阿塞拜疆大奖赛P2中于狭窄的城堡减速弯撞上护栏。
巴库会成为拉塞尔对安东内利的对决吗？
在上一站马德里落后安东内利超过三场分站胜利的积分后，拉塞尔承认，尽管他是队友在积分上最接近的挑战者，但他并未处于现实的冠军争夺中。
不过，拉塞尔周三表示，他感觉自己正处于能够再次赢得比赛的状态——自6月奥地利大奖赛以来他再未获胜——而他在巴库无疑为这一目标开了个好头，过去四年他在这里三次登上领奖台。
“他开得很好，”天空体育 F1的雅克·维伦纽夫在第二节练习赛后说。
基米·安东内利承认，在像阿塞拜疆这样的街道赛道上，P1早早退出并不“理想”，但他对第二节练习赛的恢复感到满意。
“他拉开差距的地方都在那些需要赛车精准的狭窄路段。安东内利驾驶时转向不足更多，所以在那里要付出一些代价。
“看起来这是两位（梅赛德斯）队友之间的直接较量。”

detailEn: Azerbaijan GP: George Russell fastest in second practice ahead of Kimi Antonelli in dominant start in Baku

Mercedes make a commanding start to the Azerbaijan weekend, with George Russell in early flying form; Red Bull's Max Verstappen only driver within one second of Mercedes' pace; watch final practice in Baku on Friday at 9.30am, with Qualifying at 1pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Highlights from Thursday's practice sessions at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
George Russell completed an impressive practice double as he outpaced title-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli in a dominant start to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend.

​​Mercedes' Russell built on the form that had seen him top the day's earlier first practice session to stay at the head of the timesheet, this time finishing with a half-second advantage around the challenging streets of Baku.

Antonelli, who leads Russell by 81 points in the chase for 2026's Drivers' Championship, experienced a compromised Thursday owing to the hydraulic leak that stopped his car midway through the opening session.

The Italian returned to the track with just over 30 minutes of the second session left, after an engine change, and worked his way up to second on the timesheet, eventually finishing 0.552s behind Russell.
"We lost quite a few laps in FP1 and missing half of FP2 is never ideal, especially on a street circuit," said Antonelli.
"Overall, I feel like it was a good recovery. I feel quite good in the car. A few things to work on but looking forward to tomorrow."
Max Verstappen took third to end a promising opening day in an upgraded Red Bull car, although his deficit to the front was 0.8s.
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson was not pleased with Lewis Hamilton after a near miss during the second practice session at the Azerbaijan GP.

Everyone else was over a second off the pace, including the Ferraris and McLarens. Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton were fourth and fifth respectively, with McLaren's Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri sixth and eighth.
Norris described McLaren's deficit to the front as "pretty pants".
Pierre Gasly was seventh for Alpine with the returning Isack Hadjar ninth for Red Bull and Esteban Ocon, whose Haas seat appears set to go elsewhere for 2027, 10th quickest.
Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad brought out Thursday's only red flag when he crashed in the narrow castle section of the challenging Baku lap.
Arvid Lindblad hits the barriers at the tight castle chicane during P2 at the Azerbaijan GP.
Is Baku poised to be Russell vs Antonelli?

After falling in excess of three race wins behind Antonelli last time out in Madrid, Russell admitted he was not in a realistic fight for the championship despite being his team-mate's nearest challenger in the points.

Russell, though, said on Wednesday that he felt he was in the form to win races again - something he has not done since the Austrian Grand Prix in June - and he has certainly made a positive start to that quest in Baku, where has finished on the podium in three of the past four years.
"He's driving well," said Sky Sports F1's Jacques Villeneuve after the second session.
Kimi Antonelli admits the early exit in P1 wasn't 'ideal' for a street circuit like Azerbaijan but was pleased with his recovery in the second practice session.
"Where he makes the difference is all the narrow bits where the car needs to be precise. Antonelli drives with more understeer, so pays a bit of a price there.
"It seems like a straight fight between the two [Mercedes] team-mates."

items.originalTitle: James Hinchcliffe: Williams F1 weight breakthrough brings "free lap time" in Baku
items.summaryEn: Former IndyCar driver James Hinchcliffe says Williams finally reaching Formula 1's minimum weight limit will give the team "free lap time" at this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Williams has introduced a heavily updated FW48 in Baku after struggling with an overweight car since the start of the season.
detailZh: 辛奇克利夫：威廉姆斯F1减重突破将在巴库带来“免费圈速”
詹姆斯·辛奇克利夫认为，威廉姆斯凭借升级后的FW48达到F1最低重量限制，将带来宝贵的“免费圈速”。
前IndyCar系列赛车手詹姆斯·辛奇克利夫表示，威廉姆斯终于达到F1最低重量限制，将在本周末的阿塞拜疆大奖赛为这支格罗夫车队带来“免费圈速”。
威廉姆斯自赛季初以来一直受赛车超重困扰，本站为FW48引入了大幅升级。
在F1 Nation播客中，辛奇克利夫讨论了减掉多余重量对整体性能的影响。
“这是免费圈速。它不需要调校改动，不需要驾驶能力。它简直就像马力。就是纯粹的免费圈速，所以绝对至关重要，”辛奇克利夫解释道。
“这绝对关键。这是我们从许多其他赛季初有点‘胖’的赛车身上看到的重大改进之一。想想红牛，那辆车一开始就偏重。
“所以，这对车手来说是巨大的解脱，对工程师来说也是巨大的解脱。它对一切都有帮助。它有助于刹车，有助于牵引力，有助于轮胎损耗，然后就是纯粹的圈速。所以，如果他们真的达标了，这本身对他们就是巨大的利好。”
虽然升级理论上应能帮助威廉姆斯在更靠前的位置竞争，但车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯在周末前淡化了预期。
“这是艰难的一年，而且到年底都会是艰难的一年，”这位英国人在The Fast And The Curious播客中表示。
“这毫无疑问。我们在冬季犯下的许多错误会一直伴随我们到今年年底。我们试图做的是在进入明年赛车之前让自己回到水面之上。
“今年会有一些小进步，但不足以让我达到哪怕最低的期望，也就是每个周末都能拿分。
“这根本不是我们今天的现实。不过对于明年，我认为我们会在发车格上前进吗？是的。在发车格上很难后退。我们会因此前进，但仍然会是一段艰难的苦熬。”
detailEn: James Hinchcliffe: Williams F1 weight breakthrough brings "free lap time" in Baku
James Hinchcliffe believes Williams reaching Formula 1’s minimum weight limit with its upgraded FW48 will deliver valuable “free lap time”

Former IndyCar Series driver James Hinchcliffe says Williams finally hitting Formula 1's minimum weight limit will provide the Grove outfit with "free lap time" at this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Williams has introduced a heavily updated FW48 in Baku after struggling with an overweight car since the start of the season.
During the F1 Nation podcast, Hinchcliffe discussed the impact that shedding the excess weight will have on overall performance.
"It's free lap time. It requires no set-up changes. It requires no driving ability. It is quite literally like horsepower. It's just free lap time, so it is absolutely vital," Hinchcliffe explained.

"It's absolutely crucial. It's one of the big improvements we've seen from a lot of these other cars that started the season a bit fat. You think about the Red Bull. That one started on the heavy side.

"So, that's going to be a huge relief for the drivers, a huge relief for the engineers. It helps with everything. It helps with brakes, it helps with traction, it helps with tyre degradation, and then just pure lap speed. So, if they're truly there, that in and of itself is just going to be a massive benefit for them."
While the upgrades should in theory help Williams fight higher up the grid, team principal James Vowles tempered expectations ahead of the weekend.
"It's been a tough year, and it will continue to be a tough year to the end," the Briton said during an appearance on The Fast And The Curious podcast.

"There's just no two ways about it. A lot of the mistakes that we made across the winter period will stay with us all the way until the end of this year. And what we're trying to do is put ourselves back above water by the time we get into next year's car.
"There'll be small steps this year, but they won't be enough to put us to even the bare minimum of where I'd like to be, which is scoring points for a weekend.

"That simply is not the reality of where we are today. For next year, though, do I think we'll move forward on the grid? Yes. It's hard to move backwards on the grid. We'll move forward on the grid as a result of it, but it will still be a tough old slog."
keyPointsZh: 辛奇克利夫在F1 Nation播客中称，减重无需调校改动或驾驶能力，效果如同马力，对刹车、牵引力、轮胎损耗和纯圈速都有帮助。
他以红牛为例，指出多辆赛季初偏重的赛车后来都通过减重取得明显提升。
车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯在The Fast And The Curious播客中淡化预期，称今年仍会很艰难，冬季失误的影响将持续到年底，目标是在明年赛车前回到正轨。
keyPointsEn: On the F1 Nation podcast, Hinchcliffe said shedding weight requires no set-up changes or driving ability and is like horsepower, helping with brakes, traction, tyre degradation and pure lap speed.
He cited Red Bull as an example, noting that several cars which started the season heavy have made big gains by losing weight.

Team principal James Vowles tempered expectations on The Fast And The Curious podcast, saying this year will remain tough, the winter's mistakes will stay with the team until the end of the year, and the aim is to get back above water by the time of next year's car.

detailZh: Jamie Chadwick完成威廉姆斯F1测试后加入独家名单
这位三届W Series冠军成为最新一位测试F1赛车的女性
Jamie Chadwick在波尔蒂芒为威廉姆斯完成旧车测试项目后，成为最新一位驾驶F1赛车的女性。
这位28岁的车手周一在葡萄牙驾驶去年的FW47完成了32圈，这是她作为英国车队发展车手职责的一部分。
这意味着她成为今年第二位驾驶F1赛车的女性，此前Doriane Pin完成了梅赛德斯测试，而她也是2015年Susie Wolff之后首位为威廉姆斯测试的女性。
这次测试为Chadwick辉煌的职业生涯再添一笔，她曾三次夺得W Series冠军，在Indy NXT和欧洲勒芒系列赛中赢得比赛，并担任Genesis Hypercar项目的测试车手。
自2019年起与威廉姆斯保持合作的Chadwick表示：“这是非凡的一天，一次难以置信的经历。”
“很少有事情能让你准备好驾驶F1赛车在波尔蒂芒这样的赛道上飞驰。”
“但这一切都如我想象，而且比想象中好十倍。我非常感激Atlassian威廉姆斯F1车队给予我这个机会。”
“我记得年轻时看到Susie Wolff坐进威廉姆斯F1赛车，那对我的旅程激励有多大。”
“我希望也能为下一代做到同样的事，今天我获得的经验将对我的比赛以及我能传递给后辈车手的东西产生真正的影响。”
“我非常感激，对这一天的发展感到无比高兴。这是我长久难忘的经历——我甚至可以说这是我人生迄今为止最好的一天。”
这次测试也正值葡萄牙大奖赛明年重返波尔蒂芒之前，这条阿尔加维赛道曾在2020年和2021年两次出现在赛历上。
“Jamie Chadwick激励了数百万女性和女孩，她在各个级别都打破了纪录，”威廉姆斯车队领队James Vowles说。
“她完全配得上在Atlassian威廉姆斯F1车队的这次F1测试机会。”
“在F1准备明年重返波尔蒂芒之际，Jamie为车队收集了重要数据。”
“她的反馈和表现令人印象深刻，正如我们所预料的那样。这清楚地表明女性有路径参与顶级竞争。”
“我期待看到Jamie如何利用这次经验来提升自己的驾驶，并指导我们的年轻车手了解驾驶F1赛车需要什么。”
detailEn: Jamie Chadwick joins exclusive list after Williams F1 test
The three-time W Series champion became the latest female to test an F1 car
Jamie Chadwick became the latest female to drive a Formula 1 car after completing a Testing of Previous Cars programme for Williams at Portimao.
The 28-year-old completed 32 laps in Portugal on Monday aboard the FW47 from last year, as part of her development driver duties for the British outfit.
It meant she became the second female to drive an F1 car this year after Doriane Pin completed a Mercedes test, and the first to do so for Williams since Susie Wolff in 2015.

The test has added to a glittering career for Chadwick, who has claimed three W Series titles, race wins in Indy NXT and the European Le Mans Series, plus a role as test driver for the Genesis Hypercar programme.
Chadwick, who has been affiliated with Williams since 2019, said: "It was a phenomenal day and an incredible experience.
“Few things can prepare you for driving a Formula 1 car at speed around a track like Portimao.
“But it was everything I imagined and 10 times more. I’m incredibly grateful to the Atlassian Williams F1 Team for this opportunity.
“I remember being young and watching Susie Wolff step into a Williams F1 car and how much that inspired my own journey.

“I’d love to be able to do the same for the next generation, and the experience I gained today will make a real difference both to my own racing and to what I can pass on to the drivers coming through.
“I’m so grateful and incredibly happy with how the day went. It’s an experience I’ll remember for a very long time - I’d go as far as saying it’s been the best day of my life so far."
The test also comes ahead of the return of the Portuguese Grand Prix at Portimao next year, with the Algarve circuit previously featuring on the calendar twice in 2020 and 2021.
“Jamie Chadwick is an inspiration for millions of women and girls who has broken records at every level,” said Williams team boss James Vowles.
“She has thoroughly earned this F1 test opportunity with Atlassian Williams F1 Team.
"Jamie gathered important data for the team as F1 prepares to return to Portimao next year.
“Her feedback and performance were impressive as we knew they would be. This clearly shows there is a path for women to compete at the top level.
“I look forward to seeing how Jamie uses this experience to advance her own driving and advise our young drivers on what it takes to drive an F1 car.”
keyPointsZh: Chadwick自2019年起与威廉姆斯保持合作，此次测试是其发展车手职责的一部分。
她曾三次夺得W Series冠军，并在Indy NXT和欧洲勒芒系列赛中有过胜绩，同时担任Genesis Hypercar项目的测试车手。
威廉姆斯车队领队James Vowles称赞了她的表现，并表示这证明了女性有路径参与顶级赛事。
keyPointsEn: Chadwick has been affiliated with Williams since 2019, and the test was part of her development driver duties.
She is a three-time W Series champion with race wins in Indy NXT and the European Le Mans Series, and also serves as a test driver for the Genesis Hypercar programme.
Williams team boss James Vowles praised her performance and said it clearly shows there is a path for women to compete at the top level.
